text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-29301 - hosted-inference: elevated 5xx + latency spike in eu-central-1 for /v1/chat. Auto-page to rotation -> @Aisha (sre-oncall). Links: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-29301, https://observability.redwood/internal/alerts/PD-29301

pagerduty: Page sent to Aisha (sre-oncall). Incident unacknowledged for 75s, escalating to secondary: @Miguel

Aisha: acked 1:32 UTC. I'm pulling runtime metrics. seeing a sharp memory usage climb across several hosts (runtime-eu-12, runtime-eu-14). OOM traces in kernel logs. grabbing stack traces now. :mag_right:

Priya: I pushed a scheduler tweak to the serving runtime ~40m ago to change prefetch window for KV cache (v3.2-sched). could be related to mem pressure.

Miguel: acked on escalation. standing by to assist with mitigations if Aisha needs help. I can't reach Aisha by call but saw the ack.

Aisha: quick error snippet:```GPU OOM at alloc_cuMemAlloc -> runtime-eu-14 PKT 0x3f
trace: at serving/kernel_map.c:112 allocate_kv_cache()
```

Dan: any customer impact showing up in support? cs-bot, can you forward live tickets?

cs-bot: Incoming: 2 support tickets flagged critical: NovaLabs (prod API errors ~40% 5xx), OmniPay (timeouts, elevated latency). Both on eu-central-1. Ticket links: https://support.redwood/NovaLabs/9876, https://support.redwood/OmniPay/2345

Nora: confirmed with NovaLabs 1:34 UTC  they're seeing retries and some failed payments. Escalated to priority; informing them engineers are investigating.

Aisha: mitigation plan: 1) scale up inference pool (+3 GPUs) 2) apply routing rule to send new sessions to fallback model v3.1-stable 3) enable concurrency circuit-breaker for anonymous orgs 4) collect heap + device memory dump from runtime-eu-14 5) follow-up RCA ticket. Applying now.

incident-bot: Autoscale request submitted: add 3 GPUs to pool eu-dedicated-2. ETA ~110s.

Priya: if the scheduler change is the cause, routing new traffic off the nodes running v3.2-sched should help while we investigate. I can revert the tweak after we confirm.

Aisha: traffic-split applied: new sessions -> v3.1-stable (100%) for /v1/chat. existing sessions continue. temporary rate limit: anonymous orgs concurrency = 4.

pagerduty: PD-29301 escalated to manager Helen due to missed ack window on primary+secondary.

Helen: joining bridge. thanks for the quick actions. what's status on error rate and customer experience?

Aisha: after scale+routing, 5xx rate dropped from ~42% -> ~9% over the last 2m. NovaLabs confirms partial recovery; OmniPay reports improved latency but intermittent failures persist.

Miguel: new hosts came up cleanly, memory normalized on the scaled instances. heap dumps show elevated KV cache allocations on nodes running the scheduler tweak. attaching logs to the incident doc.

Priya: reverting scheduler tweak now on canary group and rolling out rollback to remaining hosts. will monitor.

Dan: notifying SRE oncall rota that we requested extra capacity and will keep autoscale active for 20m. Also filing INF-4622 to track postmortem and follow-ups.

Nora: updated NovaLabs with: "Engineers have applied fallback routing and added capacity; service is recovering. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline." NovaLabs asked for ETA on full recovery; I gave cautious 30m.

Helen: good. keep PD incident open until we have confirmed stable metrics for 15m. please capture timeline + mitigations in the incident doc. assign owners for RCA tasks.

incident-bot: PD-29301 state: acknowledged by Aisha, Miguel. Current status: mitigated (partial). Next check-in scheduled 15m.

Aisha: collecting the heap/dump + linking to INF-4622. priority actions assigned: Priya (revert scheduler change), Miguel (analyze dumps), Dan (capacity/scale), Nora (customer comms).

Priya: revert complete on canary. no regressions observed on canary after rollback. rolling revert to remainder of pool now.

Miguel: analysis note: KV cache prefetch window increased memory retention under high concurrency; combined with a quantized kernel path in some models it pushed device memory over threshold. likely root cause but need full dump analysis.

Nora: OmniPay confirms errors down to <5% and latency back to normal for most requests. NovaLabs seeing stable success.

Helen: thanks all. we'll keep monitoring. post-incident RCA to include: timeline, code changes (Priya), model/quantized kernel interactions (ML), autoscale behavior, customer impact, and remediation checklist.

Aisha: leaving a watch on metrics for 30m, then we'll close PD and follow up in INF-4622. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
